lines: NIMHANS Bengaluru Department of Integrative Medicine Senior Research Fellowship 2022

NIMHANS Bengaluru Department of Integrative Medicine Senior Research Fellowship 2022 is an opportunity offered to graduate/postgraduate degree holders. The fellowship is on a contract basis for the Department of Health Research, ICMR funded project titled
“Double-Blind Randomized Placebo-Controlled Multicentric Clinical Trial of AYUSH M3 in the Management of Migraine”.
The selected candidate will receive an emolument of INR 35,000 per month plus 24% HRA.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Hold a Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery
Have MD/MS (Ayurveda) qualification & Research Experience after Master’s degree
Have publications and experience in the relevant area
Note - The documents must be sent as a single PDF in the same order.
